verdict.rationale: Lorikeet is a SaaS customer-experience platform, so exporting your data in open formats and leaving is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented data export, open-format download, or offboarding capability. The MCP server lets you inspect and work with workflows, and 'No migration required' describes onboarding alongside existing tools; neither is a bulk export, so both are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
